sources.title: MixGRPO: Unlocking Flow-based GRPO Efficiency with Mixed ODE-SDE
sources.snippet: Model Following DanceGRPO (Xue et al., 2025), we use FLUX.1 Dev (Labs, 2024) as the base model, which is an advanced text-to-image model based on flow matching. Overhead Evaluation For the evaluation of overhead, we use two metrics: the number of function evaluations (NFE) (Lu et al., 2022a) and the time consumption per iteration during training.

sources.snippet: In this context, the primary focus of MixGRPO is not to overcome the reward model's limitations, but rather to explore how to achieve faster convergence and superior performance under the guidance of existing, imperfect reward models.
